Body.Content:
What and why:

Starting in September 2026, users will access existing Pages in the Library tab. They can also reference existing Pages from the Copilot prompt box using the "/" menu, providing a streamlined way to find and reference Pages in chat.

As part of this update, the Edit in Pages menu in Copilot will focus on creating new Pages alongside your chat experience. This aligns the experience with the most common user workflow and simplifies how Pages are created and referenced in Copilot.

Rollout schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in late August 2026 and expect to complete by early September 2026.

[Impact on your organization:

Users will continue to be able to reference existing Pages in Copilot chats by selecting them from the "/" menu in the prompt box.

  • Existing Pages can be added to a chat through the "/" menu.
  • The Edit in Pages menu will be dedicated to creating new Pages from Copilot conversations.
  • No existing Pages, content, or sharing permissions will be affected.

Action required / Recommendations:

No action is required. The updated experience will be available automatically as the rollout reaches your organization.
